description: Two occurrences of the exact same email, byte-for-byte, must dedupe to one token (EMAIL#1) both times. Two occurrences differing only in case/whitespace must ALSO dedupe to one token, per C2's 'normalize case/whitespace for email/phone matching only' rule -- a third, unrelated email must mint a second, distinct token (EMAIL#2).
exactRepeatText: Send it to john@example.com and cc john@example.com as well.
caseVariantText: Contact John@Example.com or   john@example.com   for details.
